# Careers at Cloudtalk

CloudTalk is a Next Generation Business Calling Software for data-driven teams.

It connects businesses, teams and customers in the cloud and uses data intelligence, AI and machine learning to transform customer experiences and adapt them perfectly to the unique demands of each user. It is the VoIP solution of choice for well-known organizations like Fujitsu, Mercedes, Oyo, Revolut, DHL, and the Ministry of Health of the Slovak Republic.

CloudTalk was founded in 2018 and, over the last 4 years, has grown into an industry leader with a globally distributed team (~200 people, 30+ nationalities) and offices in 4 different cities (Toronto, Barcelona, Bratislava and Prague).

Ready to join us?
